items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: Every once in a while I used to sit in with the band, with Bill Matthews band sometimes, you know, just sitting a few minutes to play with them.

ctx.x: And you were the house band, Dale?

Well, the house band, well, that was Bill Matthews house band. Bill Matthews was there. Yeah, yeah, mm-hmm. And that was wrong, I think, wrong about, uh, uh, it must have been about 58, or something like that, when, when, when they let us go, see. Well, at that time, I started jobbing around with different fellas and everything, in, uh, I see, 58, 59, yeah. In round about 59, I joined Herbert Leary band during the Mardi Gras season. Mm-hmm. Well, I played that season with him. In round about, uh, 60, I went back…

items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: when he had his band, his band was, Celestan on trumpet, I believe he had Bill Matthews on trombone

ctx.x: Oh, excuse me. Did you say who the piano player was originally? Emma Barron.

Emma Barron. Yeah, Emma Barron. I'll call them again if you want. No, no. Emma Barron was the piano. She was already with the bass, see. But now Celestan, when he had his band, his band was, Celestan on trumpet, I believe he had Bill Matthews on trombone, and he had, who was his, his clarinet, yeah, his sax player was this boy Walter, Polo, or what is it? Polo Barnes.
